annotations.text: 4–6 home: thumbnails only, no labels. Peeku reads the title aloud when a thumbnail is focused. Focused card = mango ring.

Peeku (voice only): "What animal is that?"
No text on screen for this band. Mic ring pulses for 5 s. Whatever the kid says, Peeku models the word: "A giraffe! Gi-raffe."

Peeku (voice): "Show me the blue one."
Left / centre / right on the remote map to the three cards. One press answers. Focused card wobbles.
9–11: question shown as text plus Urdu line, video shrinks to a corner, live transcript of the answer. Peeku is calmer here, no baby talk.
Same loop on tablet (tap or big mic button). Parent digest has two shapes: words said for pre-readers, understood / shaky / dinner question for older kids.
Alternate: a light paper palette instead of deep teal. Tradeoff: friendlier on tablets in daylight, but a bright TV in a dim living room is harsh on a 4-year-old's eyes.
